name: TrueNAS ZFS server with Nextcloud and Tailscale

mentions.name: TrueNAS ZFS server with Nextcloud and Tailscale
mentions.description: This project is a server build running TrueNAS with ZFS, to be paired with Tailscale and Nextcloud as a self-hosted replacement for Dropbox.
mentions.problem: Provides a self-hosted alternative to Dropbox for file storage and sync.
mentions.source_excerpt: A server to run TrueNAS using ZFS. Going to pair it with Tailscale and Nextcloud as a replacement for Dropbox.
